text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin, having decided to enter the 
Mile Championship Nambu Hai. The venue is—

text_block_list.name: Villagers
text_block_list.text: Yukino Bijiiiiiin! Welcome baaaack!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: "Everyone! Thank yoooou so much!"

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is she the local star?! It's amazin' 
how she can run on dirt, too!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
I'm rootin' for ya! Give it all you've 
got~!
choice_data_list:
The heat on the “home” stretch is 
incredible.

The energy on the “home” stretch is 
amazing, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ehehe~. I'm truly grateful for that.

text_block_list.name: Village Umamusume Child
text_block_list.text: Yukino-chaaan! Long time no see.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Aya~! How've you been!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
She's a junior from the club I used to go 
to as a kid, y'know.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
How've ya been lately? Last time, you were 
all stoked about shaving down your time!

text_block_list.name: Village Umamusume Child
text_block_list.text: Mmm...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yer lookin' kinda down. Did somethin' 
happen?

text_block_list.name: Village Umamusume Child
text_block_list.text: —I'm thinkin' 'bout quittin' runnin'.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?! Whyyy?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
You told me when seein' me off that you'd 
run in the Central League just like me, 
didn't ya?!

text_block_list.name: Village Umamusume Child
text_block_list.text:
"Back then, sure. But when I really 
thought about it, I couldn't just leave 
pops and ma behind."

text_block_list.name: Village Umamusume Child
text_block_list.text:
To begin with, I ain't got talent or 
nothin'. I already know I can't make it to 
the Central.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Still, you didn't have to quit running 
altogether... You said you loved running, 
didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Village Umamusume Child
text_block_list.text:
Yukino-chan. I'm not just a wide-eyed kid 
dreaming anymore.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
She's still just an elementary schooler, 
ain't she?!

text_block_list.name: Village Umamusume Child
text_block_list.text:
"Even elementary schoolers understand how 
the real world works."

text_block_list.name: Village Umamusume Child
text_block_list.text:
You're gonna have to give up sooner or 
later anyway. Wouldn't it be better to 
just get it over with?

text_block_list.name: Village Umamusume Child
text_block_list.text:
Help out with the fields and live a 
carefree life like Pa and Ma. That's my 
destiny, after all.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ugh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And as post time drew near—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Nnngh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin still seemed to be hung up on 
what the village children had said.
choice_data_list: Yukino, you need to switch gears.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I know. But still...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Even though I'm running in the Tracen 
Central, I couldn't find anything helpful 
to say to her.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I get what she's sayin', too. That's why I 
can't just easily tell her, "Don't give 
up!" or whatever.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"...Well, it is selfish. If you love it 
that much, struggle for it... or something 
like that."
choice_data_list:
Then you just need to run in a way that 
makes them want to struggle to keep up.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list:
I'll show you a dream with my sparkling 
run!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Just like I dreamed... Just like what I 
learned in the Central...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
To be honest... I don't have much 
confidence. However...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I want to show her something that 
sparkles! —As the "Star of Morioka"!
